name: SimulNetDevice
author: mattyd-ip
description: Wi-Fi (wireless/WLAN) and Ethernet (wired/LAN) network status, connection state, internet ping, packet loss, and download/upload speed for dual/multiple network connections — live and simultaneous via NetworkManager — plus wireless network scanning, DHCP/static-IP address, gateway, and DNS configuration with saved profiles, primary-interface routing control, and Wi-Fi band selection.
